content.text: The document contains no exclusivity obligation on us, and expressly disclaims one.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, meeting the preferred position. Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer is free to engage any supplier and has made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC or minimum-volume commitment, and clause 2.1 confirms there is no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-flavoured restraint (12.4, Vendor shall not market a service competing with Customer's analytics products) runs against Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. No other "exclusive" reference (non-exclusive licence in 13, exclusive jurisdiction in 28.2, exclusive-remedy references in 19/21/30) creates a dealing restriction on Customer.
